summary: Smoke tested backend auth + rooms endpoints (all pass) and frontend login/admin/viewer flows. Critical UI bug found: frontend enforces PIN_LENGTH=6 but User PIN is 8 digits (00100735), so viewer role cannot log in via UI.
passed: GET /api/rooms (admin) returns 68 rooms in correct order A1..A11,B..D..,101..406
PUT /api/rooms/A2 admin occupy with nama+foto (base64) -> 200 saved
PUT /api/rooms/A2 admin is_occupied=false clears nama & foto_ktp
LoginPage keypad renders, dot indicator visible, wrong PIN triggers 401 console error (shake path)
Admin PIN 060896 auto-submits on 6th digit and redirects to /admin
AdminDashboard renders 68 room cards, filter-empty works (67 empty after cleanup), edit sheet opens with input-nama-penghuni

failed.issue: PIN_LENGTH is hardcoded to 6 in /app/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.js but User (Viewer) PIN is '00100735' (8 digits). Typing 6 digits auto-submits with '001007' which is rejected as wrong PIN. Viewer role is impossible to reach via UI.
failed.evidence: grep shows `const PIN_LENGTH = 6;` and `setPin((prev) => (prev.length < PIN_LENGTH ? prev + digit : prev));`. Test attempt to log in as user timed out on `**/viewer**` navigation; backend accepts 00100735 via direct curl.

failed.issue: `input-foto-ktp` testid was not found when edit sheet initially opens for an empty room; only `input-nama-penghuni` was present. This may be by design (foto only shown when marking occupied) but should be confirmed.
failed.evidence: Playwright query_selector('[data-testid="input-foto-ktp"]') returned null on edit sheet for empty room A1.

action_items: Fix PIN length handling in LoginPage.js: either change PIN_LENGTH to support variable-length PINs (accept up to 8 and auto-submit on match, or add a submit button), or align backend User PIN to 6 digits. Recommended: dynamic length or 8-digit support so both admin(6) and user(8) work.
(Optional) Verify input-foto-ktp is intentionally hidden until is_occupied toggle is set; ensure admin can upload photo when marking a room occupied.
